acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce with a fixture declaring >1000 directories, or refute; if reproduced, the budget scales with the declaration or the check batches reads, with a test at the boundary.
body: suspected: Observed 2026-10-15 by the V1-1399/1400/1401 lane (PR #922, BASE d47b0f01e). CommittedReadScopes reads go.work and each declared path's go.mod under the default 1,024-op budget; a .corvint/test-read-scopes.json declaring ~1000+ directories would exhaust it and make every base unknown (fail-closed, but a spurious go:test-read-scopes-invalid frontier). Not reproduced on the current declaration.
title: affected: CommittedReadScopes uses the default 1,024-op Git budget, so a large declaration makes every base unknown
